program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (crop-cells cells color)
      (let* ((norm (normalize-cells cells))
             (bb (bbox-of-cells norm)))
        (grid-from-fn (+ 1 (third bb)) (+ 1 (fourth bb))
          (lambda (r c) (if (member? (list r c) norm) color 0)))))
    (let* ((reds (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 2)) (objects g 0)))
           (sorted (sort reds (lambda (a b)
                                (cond [(not (= (obj-size a) (obj-size b))) (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b))]
                                      [else (< (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))]))))
           (target (second sorted)))
      (crop-cells (obj-cells target) 8))))
